text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Transitional Council (quasi-parliament) debates state operating budget for 1997.
- Tunisian and Algerian interior ministers say their countries need to reinforce bilateral relations.
- Law regulating political parties to be applied before legislative elections.
- Algerian activists involved in Paris bombing wave appear in French court.
- National Transitional Council envisages sharp reduction of loans for management and equipment of public sector.
- After authorities turn down their demand to hold regional demonstrations, teachers say they will not bow to pressures.
- Algeria and Cuba consider starting joint production of medicines.
- Cleaning up public busineses is inevitable to prevent industrial deadlock.
